Variants.Content: Tollett was originally a vassal family of the Royce family in the valley. Addison Tollett was called "Gloomy Eddie" after joining Night's Watch. He can always find a worse possibility among cold, death and unlucky errands, and then say it in a dry tone. That is not pure cowardice, but a way to keep yourself and your companions working in despair. Black erases the inheritance, but does not erase his upbringing, loyalty and sensitivity to the absurdities of human nature.

Night's Watch The brothers love to poke fun at Eddie's pessimism, but are also used to hearing his voice at his worst. A person who can tell cold jokes next to a frozen corpse and still finish the work he needs to do is more reliable than many people who talk about courage but run away in the face of battle.

If the valley nobles remembered the Tollett family, they would regard Eddie as a sideline child who gave up the path of inheritance. When arriving at the Great Wall, one's family background can only expose him to a few more ridicules; whether he can win respect ultimately depends on whether he joins others in starving vigil.

Ordinary black brothers think Eddie is like a rain that never stops, but his complaints rarely interfere with his duties. Some people even believe that as long as Eddie continues to predict a worse ending, the real doomsday has not yet come.
